listenings.text: Good morning, everyone. My name is Daniel Ortiz, and I am very happy to be here today. I am the finance director of a travel company in Buenos Aires. I am from Argentina, but I live in Madrid now. I am not new in this group. This is my fifth year with you. My wife and my son are here with me this week. Thank you, and have a good conference.

Hello, this is Claire from the travel desk. I am calling about your trip in October. Everything is ready. The flight is on October first, and the hotel in Paris is confirmed for three people: you, your husband and your daughter. The hotel is very close to the metro. I am in the office every day from nine to six. If you have a question, please call me. Have a wonderful trip.

paras: Dear Mrs. Ferreira, your reservation is confirmed. We are very happy to welcome you and your family in October.
Guest name: Thaís Ferreira. Guests: three people. Room 402, with one big bed and one small bed. Check-in: October 1st, after 3 p.m. Check-out: October 10th.
Breakfast is from 7 to 10 in the morning. It is included. Our reception is open every day and every night, and we speak English.
The room is not ready before 3 p.m. If you are early, you can leave your bags with us.
